Names & relationshipsThe publisher describes this community within the broader Yaqui/Yoeme context. Yaqui Nation of Texas is an alternate name for this same publisher/community, not another distinct people here. This route is separate from the Pascua Yaqui Tribe in Arizona. The2015 Senate resolution is used as name evidence; federal status, jurisdiction and the specific migration/descent account are not established by this queued entry.

Who we are — community name and alternate-name identification ↗

The publisher uses Texas Band of Yaqui Indians and Yaqui Nation of Texas for the same community. Self-description is attributed, and no federal or state legal-status determination is made.

Inspection: Identity check only

Scope: Selected name/relationship statements at web lines21–35, reinspected2026-10-26. Government-recognition, jurisdiction, descent and migration claims are not independently established by this identity check.

Review recorded: October 26, 2026

Counting note: Narrow supporting identity/relationship check; standalone history and adequacy remain queued.

Senate Resolution989 — enrolled naming record ↗

A2015 resolution honors the named Texas Band. This is supporting name evidence, not federal recognition or proof of the recited migration history.

Inspection: Identity check only

Scope: Enrolled text and May27,2015 adoption record read. Used only to verify the named community is addressed by the Senate; historical recitals and legal effects are not independently corroborated.
